clauses.text:
1. Item 30 of the Tariff of United 
States Foreign Service Fees, section V-15 
of the Foreign Service Regulations (E.O. 
No. 7968 of September 3, 1938, as 
amended by E.O. No. 8297 of December 
4, 1939; 22 CFR 105.15, 1939 Supp.), is 
hereby amended to read as follows:
Item
No. Nature of Service Fee
80 Notarial and other services No fee  
rendered officials of foreign  
governments who render gra­
tuitously reciprocal courtesies  
to officers (including military  
and naval officers) of the Gov­
ernment of the United States.

2. Sections V-49 to V-52, inclusive, of 
the Foreign Service Regulations (E.O, 
No. 7968 of September 3, 1938 ; 22 CFR 
105.49 to 105.52, 1939 Supp.) are hereby 
revoked.

3. Section V-54 (d) of the Foreign 
Service Regulations (E.O. No. 7968 of 
September 3, 1938; 22 CFR 105.54 <dl, 
1939 Supp.) is hereby amended by de­
leting from the second sentence thereof 
the wqrds “in the handwriting of the 
officer”.

EXECUTIVE ORDER 9 303
Amending  the  F oreign  S ervice R egula ­
tions  of the  U nited  S tates
By virtue of and pursuant to the au­
thority vested in me by section 1745, as 
amended, and section 1752 of the Re­
vised Statutes of the United States 
<U. S. C., title 22, secs. 127 and 132), it 
is ordered as follows:
1. Item 30 of the Tariff of United 
States Foreign Service Fees, section V-15 
of the Foreign Service Regulations (E.O. 
No. 7968 of September 3, 1938, as 
amended by E.O. No. 8297 of December 
4, 1939; 22 CFR 105.15, 1939 Supp.), is 
hereby amended to read as follows:
Item
No. Nature of Service Fee
80 Notarial and other services No fee  
rendered officials of foreign  
governments who render gra­
tuitously reciprocal courtesies  
to officers (including military  
and naval officers) of the Gov­
ernment of the United States.
2. Sections V-49 to V-52, inclusive, of 
the Foreign Service Regulations (E.O, 
No. 7968 of September 3, 1938 ; 22 CFR 
105.49 to 105.52, 1939 Supp.) are hereby 
revoked.
3. Section V-54 (d) of the Foreign 
Service Regulations (E.O. No. 7968 of 
September 3, 1938; 22 CFR 105.54 <dl, 
1939 Supp.) is hereby amended by de­
leting from the second sentence thereof 
the wqrds “in the handwriting of the 
officer”.
F ranklin  D R oosevelt
T he W hite  H ouse ,
February 11, 1943.
[F. R. Doc. 43-2286; Filed, February 12, 1943;
10:34 a. m.]

EO 9521 (Feb. 13, 1945) revoked this order only 'as of the dates of issu­ance of the orders or regulations of the Secretary of State that cover the subject-matter of and supersede' it, and no held source identifies such a Secretary of State order or regulation, or its date, for the tariff item (para. 1) or the notarial regulations changed by paras. 2 and 3. Needed: the Department of State regulations issued under EOs 9452 and 9521 (22 CFR parts 101-105, 1945-1957) that name this order, or proof that none did; then the first end is either that regulation's issuance date or 1957-03-01.

versions.research_rationale: EO 9303 (Feb. 11, 1943; 8 FR 1911) has three operative paragraphs amending the Foreign Service Regulations of EO 7968: para. 1 rewrites item 30 of the Tariff of Foreign Service Fees (no fee for notarial and other services to foreign officials who give reciprocal courtesies); para. 2 revokes secs. V-49 to V-52; para. 3 deletes 'in the handwriting of the officer' from sec. V-54(d). The 1989 Codification gives 'Revoked by EOs 9521, 10697'. EO 9521 revoked the listed orders only as of the issuance of Secretary of State regulations superseding them, and EO 9591 (1945) and EO 9767 (1946) still describe the Tariff as amended by this order, so EO 9521 had not operated on the tariff item by 1946; EO 10697 sec. 7 revoked whatever remained, effective March 1, 1957. Every clause is terminated by 1957 at the latest, but which date ends each paragraph depends on Secretary of State regulations not held, so first_end is left open. The para. 1 table is printed with the item number misread as '80' in the OCR. No human certification is asserted.

savings_residuals.reason: Neither EO 9521 nor EO 10697 preserves anything under this order (EO 9521's provisos concern the Secretary's designations and non-revival of earlier orders; EO 10697 has no savings clause and prescribes a complete new Tariff of Fees). The order's effects were fee exemptions and regulation text for consular services; services already rendered without fee are completed transactions, not continuing effects. Bounded search: this order, EO 9521, EO 9591, EO 9767 and EO 10697 in full.
